children: Senegalese President Bassirou Diomaye Faye met International Monetary Fund Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva, with both sides welcoming progress in talks and pledging to move quickly toward a new program to support the country's recovery, the West African country's presidency said on X on Tuesday.
